main_text.p: ofsium ftruem à coxa ufq; ad extremum digitorum pedis notant.
Eft autem pes in utroq; latere unus, dexter & finifter.
Pedes excipiens os eft coxa,quod transver-sis facri ofsis procesfibꝰ commissum, inter illud & femur interjacet.
Hoc os eft timembre, os ilium,os pu-bis, & os coxendicis.
Os ilium,Os ilium eft fuprema coxæ pars latis-sima,qua cum osse sacro firmisima con-nexione conjungitur.
Hoc parte posteriore duobus latis finibus infigitur, postrema parte semicirculari linea obducitur, quæ tota ap-pendice munitur.
Sinus ossis sacri tubera excipiunt: ap-pendices & partes eminentes ossis sacri sinus ingrediuntur.Femur [?]
Articulatio hæc, cum fine motu fit, Symphysis est.
Os pubis,Os pubis eft anterior coxæ pars minus lata, utrumque amplum habens foramen.
Hujus ossa multæ cartilaginis inter-ventu tenacissimè coalescunt.

page.notes: Text at the foot of the page is cut off by the scan edge; catchword "Con-" read at lower right. Signature at lower left is faint and doubtful. The left-margin word below "Sinus" is faint and doubtful (possibly "Femur" or show-through); it is marked [?]. Faint mirrored text (show-through) in the margins and across the text was left out. "firmisima" and "procesfibꝰ" are read from a small, faint print and may be inexact.
